resources.string: On your other device, choose “Link to existing device”. It shows a code. Scan that code here.
gim needs your camera to scan the code. It only uses the camera while this screen is open.
Without the camera, gim cannot scan the code. Allow camera access, or paste the code below.
Camera access is turned off for gim. Turn it on in the app settings, or paste the code below.
No camera found. Paste the code below instead.
Paste the code from your other device
Your other device shows numbers too. Tap “The numbers match” only if they are the same. The new device can then see all your chats.
Your new device is linked. Your chats will show up on it soon.
The new device was not linked.
This code doesn’t work. Make a new code on your other device and scan it again.
Can’t connect to the server. Check your internet and try again.
